correctness.rationale: The exact 462-vertex domain and graph metric are defined. For every zero-sum vector, the Johnson decomposition supplies five nonconstant powered-distance eigenbranches with multiplicities 10,44,110,165,132. The fourth branch has a unique crossing by a globally strict derivative bound. The exact integer-power interval certificate places this root in (71/200,89/250) and proves the other four branches strictly negative on that entire interval. Schoenberg fractional-power closure proves all lower exponents; the positive fourth branch excludes all larger ones. Endpoint rank is 461-165=296. Independently replayed code verifies all distance/intersection matrices and the spectral rows; numerical checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: The 462-vertex O6 is the canonical valency-six odd graph, not an arbitrary induced subgraph or chosen graph parameter slice. Universal positivity of exp(-t d^p) for all bandwidths is a natural embedding/kernel invariant; the calculation identifies the non-top harmonic that first obstructs positivity, gives an exact finite-dimension crossing certificate, and determines a 165-dimensional degeneracy and sharp 296-dimensional squared-Euclidean embedding at its boundary. These conclusions go beyond merely evaluating the ordinary distance spectrum and motivate further harmonic-mode comparisons on odd graphs.
